writeup: These BBsecure black stove knob safety covers come as a 5-pack with a dual-button lock, 3M adhesive, and heat-resistant plastic. Woot has the set for $5.99, listed as new. My Thrifty Mom lists the same BBsecure black 5-pack, matching Shopify SKU B0FF4HY61Q, in stock at $50.04 CAD. There are at least three left, with a purchase limit of three per customer.
